info.name: Turntide WordPress REST Wp Abilities/v1 API

description.content: The WordPress REST API surface published by Turntide Technologies at https://turntide.com/wp-json/. This document was DERIVED mechanically from the live route index -- every path, method and parameter below appears in that index -- and component schemas were harvested from live HTTP OPTIONS responses on the core wp/v2 collections. It covers the corporate website's content/CMS surface plus the WordPress Abilities API (wp-abilities/v1) and an MCP adapter namespace (mcp). It is NOT a product API for Turntide's motors, power electronics, energy storage or thermal hardware -- Turntide publishes no public developer API for those products.
